title: What We Are Asking For
subtitle: Selective resources and partnerships to validate and evolve a coordination-first creative platform.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: PonyLife is at an early but structurally defined stage.
The core model has been articulated, and the focus now is on validation rather than rapid scaling.
At this stage, the platform does not seek speculative growth or aggressive expansion.

sections.heading: What We Are Looking For
bullets: Strategic capital (selective): to support development, experimentation, and operational stability
Strategic partners: organizations that understand coordination problems in creative/digital ecosystems
Domain expertise: creative economies, rights management, digital platforms, applied Web3 infrastructure

sections.heading: Strategic Capital (Selective)
paragraphs: We are open to strategic funding that supports platform development, experimentation, and operational stability.
Funding is intended to extend runway, reduce execution risk, and enable focused experimentation — not to drive token price dynamics.

sections.heading: Strategic Partners
paragraphs: We are actively looking for partners who understand coordination problems in creative or digital ecosystems.

sections.heading: Domain Expertise
paragraphs: We seek collaboration with individuals and organizations experienced in creative economies, rights management, digital platforms, and applied Web3 infrastructure.
This expertise is critical to stress-test assumptions, refine the coordination model, and avoid structural blind spots.

sections.heading: What We Are Not Looking For
bullets: Pressure to reposition the token as a financial product

sections.heading: Why Engage at This Stage
paragraphs: Early engagement offers influence over the system’s direction, not guaranteed returns.
Participants at this stage gain insight into emerging coordination models, exposure to early experimentation results, and the ability to shape platform evolution.

sections.heading: Closing Statement
paragraphs: PonyLife is an exploration of how creative value behaves under coordinated conditions.
We are building the infrastructure to run that exploration responsibly and transparently.
